_comment: Exam dates for the README countdown badges (scripts/build-readme-live.mjs). Add a year once the official notice is out and set confirmed to true. When a year is missing the script falls back to the rule below, so a stale file never breaks the badge.
_confirm: 高考: 教育部 announces each spring (the national papers start on 7 June). 考研: 研招网 (yz.chsi.com.cn) publishes the 初试 dates with the registration notice, usually in September or October. 国考: 国家公务员局 (scs.gov.cn) publishes the 笔试 date with the recruitment notice, usually in October.

2027.note: The national papers have started on 7 June every year since 2003

kaoyan.label: 考研初试
kaoyan.rule: the Saturday between 19 and 25 December (2022: 24 Dec, 2023: 23 Dec, 2024: 21 Dec, 2025: 20 Dec)

2026.source: 教育部《2027年全国硕士研究生招生工作管理规定》, published September 2026: 初试 19 and 20 December 2026

guokao.label: 国考笔试
guokao.rule: the last Saturday of November, a day either side in some years (2023: 26 Nov, 2024: 30 Nov, 2025: 30 Nov)

2026.note: Forecast for the 2027 national exam; the notice is due mid-October 2026 at bm.scs.gov.cn
